excerpt_en: Students must clear their fees by the 18th of Ashoj in order to receive their admit card; otherwise, they will not be allowed to sit for the examination. The school will remain closed from the 31st of Ashoj until the 8th of Kartik 2083 and will reopen on the 9th of Kartik. The results of the 2nd Terminal Examination will be published on the 13th of Kartik 2083.
excerpt_np: प्रवेशपत्र प्राप्त गर्न विद्यार्थीहरूले असोज १८ गतेभित्र आफ्नो शुल्क बुझाउनुपर्नेछ; अन्यथा, उनीहरूलाई परीक्षामा सामेल हुन दिइने छैन। विद्यालय २०८३ सालको असोज ३१ गतेदेखि कात्तिक ८ गतेसम्म बन्द रहनेछ र कात्तिक ९ गते पुनः खुल्नेछ। दोस्रो त्रैमासिक परीक्षाको नतिजा २०८३ सालको कात्तिक १३ गते प्रकाशित गरिनेछ।

excerpt_en: All parents of Classes 6–10 are requested to attend the PTM on Saturday at 10:00 AM in the main hall.
excerpt_np: कक्षा ६–१० का सबै अभिभावकहरूलाई शनिबार बिहान १०:०० बजे मुख्य हलमा हुने भेटघाटमा उपस्थित हुन अनुरोध छ।

excerpt_en: The school will remain closed for the festive season. Classes resume as per the academic calendar.
excerpt_np: चाडपर्वको अवसरमा विद्यालय बन्द रहनेछ। शैक्षिक पात्रो अनुसार कक्षा सञ्चालन हुनेछ।

excerpt_en: Students from Classes 5–10 will display working models. Parents and community members are warmly invited.

title_en: Annual Sports Day 2082 — All Parents Invited

excerpt_en: Join us for a full day of athletics, football, volleyball and cultural performances by our students.

excerpt_en: Applications are open for Nursery to Class 10. Limited seats available — apply early to secure your child's place.
